info.name: GoldGraft fourteen payment scenarios — planning only
info.description: No executable requests. Qualified broker/runner/callback and accepted interfaces required before adding any payment operations.

item.name: S01 Create, approve, capture and return
item.description:
Reconcile shop order, provider capture and amounts; HTTP success alone is insufficient.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC04, AC19

item.name: S02 Buyer cancellation
item.description:
No paid/fulfilled state or replacement payment inferred from browser cancellation.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC04, LC17

item.name: S03 Declined payment
item.description:
No fulfillment; preserve observed provider outcome and associated intent.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC03, LC04

item.name: S04 Pending then completed
item.description:
Pending is not paid; later verified completion produces one transition.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC03, LC18

item.name: S05 Payer action when supported
item.description:
Record actual account/product support; unavailable required flow is a hold, not a silent skip.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC04, LC07

item.name: S06 Duplicate submit / two tabs
item.description:
One logical payment intent and one economic effect; losing response cannot overwrite winner.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC17, LC30

item.name: S07 Lost response / restart / retry
item.description:
Preserve original API-specific idempotency identity; reconcile unknown effects without fresh-key retry.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC17, LC30

item.name: S08 Full refund / repeated refund
item.description:
Use original API/account/object IDs; check remaining amount; distinguish pending and completed; no excess refund.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC17, LC22

item.name: S09 IPN authenticity and business checks
item.description:
Preserve raw bytes; verified identity, recipient, amount and currency before financial effects.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC18, LC37

item.name: S10 IPN pending/completed/duplicate/late pending
item.description:
State-aware dedupe; one fulfillment; no state regression; later legitimate financial events retained.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC18

item.name: S11 Webhook authenticity / duplicate / wrong listener
item.description:
Bind raw-body verification to sandbox app/listener; mock simulator evidence stays separate.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC18, LC19

item.name: S12 Callback outage / reconciliation
item.description:
Durable receipt before acknowledgement; no effect before verification; absent reporting is not proof of no charge.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC19, LC37

item.name: S13 Order persistence and restart
item.description:
Retain order/payment correspondence and state; no concurrent flat-file writers or restoration over new payments.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC20, LC34

item.name: S14 Amount / currency tampering
item.description:
USD shop charge must equal trusted order amount and intended recipient; no multicurrency support inferred.
Status: BLOCKED for genuine payment execution. Acceptance: LC03, LC04
